recognize_zh: 三顆中等大小的淋巴樣細胞聚在一起，核不規則、有凹陷，染色質中度濃縮，細胞質深藍且邊緣有明顯的小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這種嗜鹼性、帶突起的細胞質是 T-PLL 細胞常見的特徵。
features: Cluster of three medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small mature lymphocytes
Moderate to high N:C ratio with irregular, indented to slightly lobulated nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli are not conspicuous at this magnification
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Background red cells with some elongated and teardrop-like shapes, likely partly smear-related
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of three medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs. No cytoplasmic granules are seen. In the context of a lymphocytosis, these features are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia (small-cell/irregular nuclear variant morphology), pending immunophenotypic and TCL1A rearrangement confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells show cerebriform nuclei with fine linear grooves and scant pale cytoplasm, and are typically CD7 and CD26 negative, whereas T-PLL cells have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm and are CD7 bright.
ATLL cells have markedly polylobated 'flower' nuclei and are CD25 bright with HTLV-1 serology positive, unlike the less lobated nuclei here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and coarse 'soccer-ball' chromatin, lack cytoplasmic basophilia and blebs, and express CD19/CD23.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules and round nuclei, unlike the agranular basophilic blebbed cytoplasm here.
